stories.title: Russian Armed Forces struck depots containing military equipment at Odessa port
stories.summary: During the day combat unmanned aerial vehicles hit warehouses containing military supplies intended for the Armed Forces of Ukraine at the port of Odessa
article_sentences: Russian troops struck warehouses containing military equipment intended for the Ukrainian army at the port of Odessa, the Russian Defense Ministry reported.
"During the day combat unmanned aerial vehicles hit warehouses containing military supplies intended for the Armed Forces of Ukraine at the port of Odessa," the report said.
